sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Brucebase feed on MusicBrainz: BruceParser compares the artist's MusicBrainz events with Brucebase, and an event whose Brucebase "reviews" link is doubtful is marked on its Event cell in every event list (an artist's, a place's, an area's events, event collections, event tags) and beside its Brucebase link on its own page. ❌ the link reaches no entry (197 events in the run of 2026-11-15, 172 of them because the wiki now writes that date with a letter: 2023#120923 against #120923a and #120923b), ⚠️ two events link one entry (18; the one whose date differs from the entry's is called likely wrong), ⚠️ the link is a show's page, not its year-page anchor (1).

Hover a mark: the card lists the wiki's entries of the event's date as links to the year page, the one whose heading names the event's place marked likely, so the link can be corrected. No request to MusicBrainz or the wiki: an event list's or an event page's press reads the feed at most once a day, shared with Brucebase. New setting "Read the Brucebase feed on MusicBrainz too" (on), a switch for each finding and one tint.

sections.label: 📝 Docs
items: Needs the feed of BruceParser 0.21.0 on GitHub; an older feed marks nothing on MusicBrainz.
